author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Principled Regularization: PCA Whitening + DAQB
abstract: This experiment tests PCA whitening as a principled replacement for the ad-hoc variance regularization of my SOTA (1500 HVGs + FWPCA). The pipeline is `log1p -> 2000 HVGs -> PCA -> Whitening -> DAQB`. The hypothesis is that this direct regularization method will achieve a score comparable or superior to my current SOTA, providing a more elegant and understandable solution.
